input: Hi there, I’m writing in a bit of a rush because I’m stuck in traffic and need to sort this out before my next meeting. I recently referred a colleague to Northwind Outdoor, and they just placed their first order. They spent exactly $50.00 on a new bike light and some gear, which I believe meets the minimum threshold for the referral program. However, I haven’t received the $20.00 credit yet, and my account shows no pending rewards. I know the system usually processes these automatically, but given the timing, I’m worried it might have been missed or flagged as an error. Since I’m relying on this credit to cover my own upcoming purchase, could you please check if there’s any way to expedite this or manually apply the $20.00 to my account? I’m not trying to cause trouble, just hoping for a quick resolution so I can move on with my day. Thanks for your help.
prompt:

Then verify each one is present in the excerpts. Include every fact you find, with the exact value as written (e.g. "$15.00 Express upgrade fee", "within 48 hours", "5 points per $1.00"). If the ticket asks for more than one piece of information, cover them all.

Citation discipline. Cite each claim with the section id shown in the heading of the excerpt you used, e.g. [returns]. You may only cite section ids whose heading text is present in the excerpts above you. Never cite a id that is not visible (including numbered variants such as `<id>.1`). Never assert a policy detail that is not literally in the excerpts. If a needed fact is absent from the excerpts, do not fill it in — say which specific fact the excerpts do not contain and offer to escalate the ticket to a human agent.

Do not hedge the facts. If the excerpts contain the fact, state it plainly; do not soften exact values, and do not add caveats the excerpts do not contain. Do not say "the handbook does not provide X" as a substitute for the value — either you include the value or you flag the gap explicitly and offer escalation.

Be direct and concise. Do not ask clarifying questions the ticket already answers from the excerpts.
